content.value: Make sentences on the following structures using the verb given in brackets. (14) [CO1]
i) Subj. + Intransitive verb + adverbial of manner. (dance as verb)
ii) Subj. + Linking verb + adjective complement. (act as verb)
iii) Subj. + Linking verb + noun complement. (prove as verb)
iv) Subj. + Transitive verb + gerund as object. (start as verb)
v) Subj. + Transitive verb + obj. + adj. complement. (judge as verb)
vi) Subj. + Transitive verb + obj. + noun complement. (call as verb)
vii) Subj. + Transitive verb + obj. + obj. (explain as verb)
